Coram : PANKAJ MITHAL*, PRASHANT KUMAR MISHRA
Issue for Consideration Appellants if had easementary right of the way over the land owned by the respondents i.e. the disputed rasta. Appellants’ reliance upon the evidence of their Power of Attorney holder/Manager of the property (PW-1) to prove their easementary right disputed rasta, if proper. Headnotes Easements Act, 1882 – ss.4, 13, 15 – “Easementary right” – Easementary right by prescription or necessity – When not proved: Held: ‘Easement’ u/s.4 is a right which the owner or occupier of a land possesses for
